summary: The preparer directed readers to revised Table 1-1 and Section 9 in response to the road relocation and access road responsibility concerns, and again to revised Section 9 regarding coordination during transmission line construction.
text:
See revised Table 1-1 and Section 9.
We do not anticipate that the new transmission line which will cross both S. C. Route 11 and S. C. 183 will have an adverse impact on the traffic-carrying functions of these two facilities, but we would expect close coordination with the Highway Department during construction to assure that any disruption in these activities would be minimized.
